source.identity_method: Every ordinal HEAD~400..HEAD~415 fetched directly; compare used only for range consistency.

ordinal_dispositions.summary: Entity summaries and notifications were truncated to 15 words for overlay cleanliness. Useful projection compression, but canonical/full source memory must remain independently addressable; UI brevity must not become destructive memory loss.

Added direct /llm restart path bypassing inference and reporting bounded success/failure. Recovery controls should remain deterministic and independent of the component being repaired, with explicit authorization/audit in current harnesses.

Entity questions gained direct entity-DB recall injection plus explicit anti-fabrication prompt rules. This repaired missing recall, but prompt honesty is only a policy layer; truth still depends on provenance-correct retrieval and source coverage.

Replaced immediate second-pass reflection with delayed depth-2 reflection gated by idle/hardware/mood state and fed outputs into Titan/E-PQ/goals. Temporal distance and depth provenance are useful, but self-generated reflections remain derived evidence and can self-reinforce if promoted as independent truth.
ABOUT.md architecture/consciousness/safety claims updated. Preserved as historical self-description only; no code/runtime mechanism credit.
HOW_IT_WORKS.md comprehensively updated. Useful historical topology description, not independent evidence that described integrations or learning semantics actually worked.
README removed deprecated components and refreshed system inventory. Also previously served as a false apparent history-root candidate; documentation/search recency is not provenance completeness.

Fresh Ubuntu container exposed package-name/dependency/PYTHONPATH/user-bus failures. A service definition is not deployable capability unless its environment/import/dependency closure and process-manager context are valid.

Architecture and memory documents rewritten with strong consciousness, memory and auto-training descriptions. Retained as claims/index hints; code evidence is required, especially where docs label persistence or heuristics as learning/emergence.

Fixed ego auto-train bugs by checking whether predefined sensation/affect IDs were already persisted rather than caller-mutated activation counters. This exposes a key epistemic distinction: persisting an existing default mapping after it fires is not learning a new sensor→sensation mapping.

Added hard-coded attention→workspace channel weights, reflection-keyword→E-PQ events, Genesis proposal→E-PQ/prompt bridges, ego default persistence and energy fixes. These are explicit designed couplings, not evidence of emergently learned weighting. Historical self-modification paths are not promoted to current Frank harness authority.

Short skill keyword 'at' matched inside 'atlas', routing entity-memory questions to cron-helper; word boundaries fixed collision. Same commit notes an FTS recent/search dead zone. Routing and recall failures can masquerade as memory failure.

Overhauled fresh/reinstall path with force overwrite, dependency closure, PYTHONPATH across services, fail-soft wallpaper, model fallback, autostart and service startup. Reinstall semantics must distinguish source bundle from installed tree and prove booted capability after writing artifacts.

FTS query construction dropped late meaningful keywords and exclude_recent=10 vs recent_count=5 created messages visible to neither recent nor search paths. Retrieval windows must partition/cover the source set without gaps and query preprocessing must preserve discriminative terms.
Context builder labeled every non-user message as Frank, erasing entity sender identity. Correct recall requires preserving source/actor attribution through projection, not only retaining text.

Entity session summaries were previously isolated in entity DB/transcripts, so chat/Titan recall could not see them. Added Titan and chat_memory ingestion. Replicated summaries must carry shared source/session identity so copies do not become duplicate independent evidence.

retina_transfer.mapping: Retina must use the same end-to-end provenance discipline: sensor/frame→feature/classifier→state delta→graph/workspace→model. A displayed or compressed percept is not canonical sensor evidence; self-rendered visuals are endogenous; DEFAULT_PERSISTED cannot be scored as classifier learning; learned visual mappings require actual parameter/rule adaptation with held-out validation.

negative_results.result: Entity sessions existed in local stores yet were not recallable because they were not ingested into the stores chat actually queried.
Text survived retrieval but wrong sender attribution changed its meaning/provenance.
Messages 6-10 fell into a retrieval dead zone; significant entity keyword could be removed by naive first-word query extraction.
Short substring skill keyword diverted a memory question into an unrelated cron skill.

Activation counters mutated by unrelated callers made recurrence-based persistence unreliable; direct DB existence was substituted, revealing that the mechanism was persistence of defaults rather than genuine mapping discovery.
Reflection→personality and attention→channel weighting were explicit keyword/constant couplings; dynamic behavior alone is insufficient evidence of learned/emergent coupling.
